1: # read the csv
2: dat <- read.csv("../data/semlavaan.csv", header=TRUE, fileEncoding="CP932")
3: 
4: library(lavaan)
5: # https://lavaan.ugent.be/
6: model <- '
7: Achievement =~ Midterm + Final + Quiz
8: Proficiency =~ Exam1 + Exam2 + Exam3
9: Proficiency ~ Achievement
10: '
11: 
12: fit <- sem(model, data=dat)
13: summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)
14: 
15: # Path diagram
16: library(semPlot)
17: 
18: # Standardized estimates
19: png("../results/plot1.png", width = 600, height = 600)
20: semPaths(fit, "std", style="lisrel", # LISREL style
21:          mar=c(6,1,3,1), # margin (bottom, left, up, right)
22:          edge.label.cex=.8, # font size for coefficients
23:          fade=F, # keep the arrow size the same
24:          theme="gray") # gray color
25: dev.off()
